# k0rdent_address_pool (Data Source)

One AddressPool, by name.

Use `k0rdent_address_pools` when the name is not known ahead of time, or to pick by `routable`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One AddressPool by name. `k0rdent_address_pools` lists them.

data "k0rdent_address_pool" "tenant" {
  id = "tenant"
}

# A subnet's `address_pool` takes the pool's `self_link`, not its `id`.
resource "k0rdent_subnet" "pods" {
  id            = "pods"
  network       = "training-fabric"
  address_pool  = data.k0rdent_address_pool.tenant.self_link
  prefix_length = 24

  # Fail the plan, not the apply, if the pool isn't active or can't give a /24.
  lifecycle {
    precondition {
      condition     = data.k0rdent_address_pool.tenant.state == "active"
      error_message = "Pool ${data.k0rdent_address_pool.tenant.id} is ${data.k0rdent_address_pool.tenant.state}, not active."
    }
    precondition {
      condition = (
        data.k0rdent_address_pool.tenant.min_prefix_length <= 24 &&
        data.k0rdent_address_pool.tenant.max_prefix_length >= 24
      )
      error_message = "Pool ${data.k0rdent_address_pool.tenant.id} serves /${data.k0rdent_address_pool.tenant.min_prefix_length} to /${data.k0rdent_address_pool.tenant.max_prefix_length}, so it cannot serve a /24."
    }
  }
}

output "reserved_ranges" {
  value = data.k0rdent_address_pool.tenant.exclude_ranges
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The pool's name. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.

### Optional

- `region` (String) Region to read. Defaults to the provider's `region`. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Free-form text describing it, for people to read.
- `display_name` (String) Human-friendly name, for display only.
- `exclude_ranges` (List of String) Addresses inside `prefixes` the operator has reserved. A subnet allocated from this pool will never contain them. Sorted lexically by range.
- `ip_version` (String) IP family of every prefix in the pool. IPv4 only, today.
- `max_prefix_length` (Number) Largest `prefix_length` a subnet may ask this pool for. Defaults to `30` on IPv4; `/32` is permitted where the operator has raised it, for a single-host case such as a control-plane VIP.
- `min_prefix_length` (Number) Smallest `prefix_length` a subnet may ask this pool for. Defaults to `8` on IPv4.
- `prefixes` (List of String) The blocks subnets are allocated from. Sorted lexically by prefix.
- `routable` (Boolean) Whether subnets from this pool are reachable from outside the tenant VPC. A subnet's `allocate_gateway` only takes effect on a routable pool.
- `self_link` (String) Platform-defined reference to this pool. **This is the value a `k0rdent_subnet` takes as its `address_pool`.**
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state. A pool that is not `active` cannot be allocated from.

## Related

- [`k0rdent_address_pools`](../data-sources/address_pools.md) data source: lists every one.
- [`k0rdent_subnet`](../resources/subnet.md) resource: takes the pool's `self_link` in `address_pool`.
